study.title: Multi-Class Weed Quantification Based on U-Net Convolutional Neural Networks Using UAV Imagery
study.short_title: Residual U-Net potato multi-class weed mIoU 80.21

segmentation.domain: Multi-class (6 classes) semantic segmentation and weed quantification on UAV RGB potato-field imagery under uncontrolled conditions using five U-Net variants (Original, Residual, Double, Modified/MU-Net, AU-Net), optimized for silhouette fidelity and weed coverage estimation; KDD methodology; patch-based 128x128 training with class balancing
models_tested: AU-Net (U-Net with 4 Attention Gate modules + residual blocks)
segmentation.best_model: Residual U-Net on the extended (balanced) dataset: test-set mean IoU 0.8021 (210 test images); validation metrics (210 images): Dice Loss 0.1236, Mean Dice Coefficient 0.8763, mean IoU 0.8053; overall accuracy 82.4% (Table 6). Trained on Google Colab Pro+ (Nvidia A100 40 GB), TensorFlow/Keras 2.8.0, 100 epochs in ~2.5 h; ~135 M trained parameters, 515 MB; inference 58.5 ms (~17 fps) per 128x128 patch. Beat the prior ResNeXt50 work (mIoU 0.7350) by 9.1% and all other variants tested here (Original 0.6542, Double 0.6488, MU-Net 0.6790, AU-Net 0.6150 on validation)

dataset.name: Custom potato-weed UAV dataset from northern Ecuador, released publicly (github.com/JorgePazos-git 'Dataset of weeds in potato crops in the province of Carchi and Imbabura'): 3810 raw RGB images (5472x3648) from 8 potato fields in Carchi and Imbabura provinces, crop age ~15-40 days, May 2023-April 2024; acquired with a DJI Mavic 2 Pro and Android DroneDeploy v5.7; 2100 annotated 250x250 sub-images (resized to 128x128, ~62.5 cm x 62.5 cm ground footprint) containing 8119 annotated plant instances (Broadleaf dock 1334, Dandelion 1448, Kikuyu 1838, other weeds 1661, potato 1838); 210 work-hours of annotation via Roboflow; dataset ~56% larger and balanced relative to the prior work [19]. Split 80/10/10 stratified at the raw-image level (1680 train / 210 val / 210 test) to avoid spatial leakage; 7 augmentation types applied to training only -> 11,760 training sub-images.
dataset.note: Author-collected with a DJI Mavic 2 Pro RGB drone at 9-10 m flight height (midpoint 9.5 stored), 1 m/s, GSD 0.25 cm/pixel (0.0025 m). Original frames post-processed to 2802x1868 for quantification; images divided into 250x250-pixel patches (62.5 cm x 62.5 cm ground) then resized to 128x128 for the U-Net. Train-set pixel distribution: background 83.35%, Potato 4.60%, Dandelion 4.39%, Broadleaf dock 3.47%, Kikuyu 2.95%, other weeds 1.24%.

segmentation.backbone: U-Net encoder-decoder with 3x3 Conv2D head (6 filters, softmax). Variants: Residual U-Net (residual blocks, ~135 M params, 515 MB), Double U-Net (U-Net stacked on Residual U-Net, ~116 M params, 443 MB), Modified U-Net MU-Net (Resblock + Respath, ~14 M params, 54 MB), AU-Net (4 Attention Gate modules AG1-AG4 at 16x16/32x32/64x64/128x128 + residual blocks, ~93 M params, 355 MB). Adam (lr 0.001), sparse categorical cross-entropy, 100 epochs (batch 32; Residual U-Net batch 16); EarlyStopping + ReduceLROnPlateau.

mIoU.quote: Overall, the Residual U-Net model performs well on the test set with a mean IoU = 0.8021
mIoU.ambiguity: Test set (210 of 2100 sub-images, 10%). Per-class IoU: background 0.9721, potato 0.9376, Broadleaf dock 0.7984, Kikuyu 0.7730, Dandelion 0.7409, other weeds 0.5907. Validation-set mean IoU 0.8053 (balanced dataset, Table 3) vs 0.7755 on the original unbalanced dataset; similarity to test (<=0.4%) supports generalization. Reported as percentage in the paper; stored as fraction.

mPA.ambiguity: Pixel accuracy not reported; the paper explicitly prefers IoU over overall accuracy for unbalanced segmentation (evaluation metrics are Dice Loss, Mean Dice Coefficient, Mean IoU; plus per-class IoU on the test set).

F1.ambiguity: F1 not reported; only IoU, Dice Loss and Mean Dice Coefficient evaluation metrics.

Dice.quote: Residual U-Net (balanced extended dataset) ... a mean Dice Coef cient of 0.8763
Dice.ambiguity: Validation set (10%, 210 images) for the balanced Residual U-Net. Test-set Dice not reported (test-set results are per-class IoU only, Table 4). Other models (validation): Original 0.7576, Double 0.7529, MU-Net 0.7764, AU-Net 0.6647. Reported as percentage in the paper; stored as fraction.

PA.ambiguity: Overall accuracy 82.4% for the Residual U-Net appears only in the literature-comparison table (Table 6) without separate derivation in the results text (which uses only IoU/Dice metrics and argues OA is less robust). Recorded as PA with reduced confidence; may reflect a different evaluation setting.

weed_F1.ambiguity: Per-class F1 not reported; per-class IoU reported instead (Dandelion 0.7409, Kikuyu 0.7730, Broadleaf dock 0.7984, other weeds 0.5907).

crop_F1.ambiguity: Per-class crop F1 not reported; potato-class IoU 0.9376 reported instead.

edge.device: None - offline. Models trained and inferred on Google Colab Pro+ (Nvidia A100 GPU 40 GB VRAM, 83.5 GB RAM). Paper notes the 515 MB Residual U-Net is 'large for UAV-based scouting' and recommends future lightweight model compression (pruning, quantization, knowledge distillation) to enable on-device embedded inference; inference speed measured on the cloud GPU only.
edge.framework: TensorFlow/Keras 2.8.0 on Google Colab Pro+ (Nvidia A100 40 GB); Adam (lr 0.001), sparse categorical cross-entropy, 100 epochs (Residual U-Net batch size 16)

fps.quote: a relatively fast inference time of 58.5 ms (17 fps) per 128 x 128 image patch (model input size), occupying 515 MB of storage
fps.ambiguity: edge.reported=false: measured on Google Colab Pro+ (Nvidia A100), not embedded/on-device hardware. 17 fps per 128x128 patch as stated (1000/58.5 ms). Authors claim compatibility with 'near real-time processing' in post-flight workflows; real-time/energy evaluation explicitly deferred to future work.

latency_ms.quote: in a relatively fast inference time of 58.5 ms (17 fps) per 128 x 128 image patch (model input size)
latency_ms.ambiguity: edge.reported=false: per 128x128 image patch on the Nvidia A100 (Google Colab Pro+), not on edge hardware. Real-world full-resolution UAV images would use a sliding-window tiling strategy.

power_w.ambiguity: Power consumption not reported; detailed inference time/energy evaluation explicitly out of scope.

params_M.quote: The Residual U-Net model maintains the basic architecture of the U-Net but with skip connections in multiple layers. The total trained parameters were nearly 135 M, with a size of 515 MB.
params_M.ambiguity: Structural parameter count of the best model (Residual U-Net); not an edge deployment. Others: Double U-Net ~116 M (443 MB), MU-Net ~14 M (54 MB), AU-Net ~93 M (355 MB).

issues: edge.reported=false: fps/latency (17 fps, 58.5 ms) measured on a cloud GPU (Google Colab Pro+ Nvidia A100), not embedded hardware; values recorded for reference with ambiguity notes.
PA reported at reduced confidence: overall accuracy 82.4% appears only in the literature-comparison Table 6 without derivation in the results text.
uav_collected=true: authors collected the dataset with a DJI Mavic 2 Pro and released it publicly (GitHub).
No per-class F1; only per-class IoU (Table 4) available.
Mean Dice Coefficient 0.8763 is a validation-set value; test set reports per-class IoU only.
